verdict.rationale: The evidence covers flags, A/B, multivariate and bandit tests, a visual editor, SDKs and management APIs, but nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside the product. The MCP server and llms.txt probes concern external agent and documentation access, which is a different capability and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
